tasks.spec:
You are a specification writer revising a draft around the owner's architectural ruling. OFFLINE: no network, no git, no MCP, no skills; write only ./SPEC-v94-draft2.md.

OWNER'S ARCHITECTURAL RULING (Ankit, tonight): stop optimizing for scenarios - the conversation must hold ONE PERSISTENT GOAL (intent: book exam; date range; time preference; status) that STAYS until satisfied. Every patient message is a goal UPDATE; the system then ATTEMPTS the goal (one availability call for the current range) and RESPONDS (offers, or ONE targeted question when the update was ambiguous or the range came back empty); the goal never resets, only refines, until booked or abandoned. Convergence must be structural (there is no node to get stuck on - only the loop), not proven scenario-by-scenario.

BASE DRAFT to revise: /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workV94spec/draft-spec-v94/SPEC-v94-draft.md (read fully - keep its node-contraction evidence, copy inventory, validator and harness plans, but REBUILD its spine as the goal loop). Supporting evidence: /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workSimplify/flow-structure-eval/report.md (duplication inventory) and /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/pathway-v92.json (current graph).

LOCKED RULINGS unchanged (embed verbatim in a Rulings section): HYBRID interpretation stays (pathway extracts, gateway re-interprets - the gateway is the goal interpreter and echoes the authoritative goal back each call so pathway and gateway cannot silently diverge); at most ONE clarifying question per ambiguity, fail-open-to-search never fail-stay, at most one re-ask; clock times only from fresh slot data and ONLY in the offer step; both filler sentences banned; corrections resolve offer-relative (offered date + 7); no booking claims outside confirmation; mandated close copy unchanged; <=15s per answer; CVC out of scope.

WRITE ./SPEC-v94-draft2.md, sections: 1. SPINE - the goal loop stated in five lines (UPDATE -> ATTEMPT -> RESPOND -> loop; guards outside the loop: booked-defer, help/office, confirm, close). 2. GOAL OBJECT - the exact persistent variables (names, types, who writes each: pathway extraction vs gateway echo), the status lifecycle (unsatisfied -> offered -> confirmed / abandoned), and the drift-repair rule (gateway echo wins on disagreement, per the hybrid ruling). 3. NODE MAP - every v94 node (target 8-14) with purpose, and the v92-to-v94 contraction table showing where each of the 48 current nodes lands. 4. TURN CONTRACT - what happens on ANY patient message, as one deterministic sequence, including the ambiguity branch (one question, candidates from the gateway) and the empty-range branch (nearest alternatives, never invention). 5. EXTRACTION DEFINITION - the single canonical extraction config (once). 6. AVAILABILITY FUNNEL - the single request contract. 7. COPY INVENTORY - surviving patient-facing strings, EN + ZH-parity checklist. 8. VALIDATOR PLAN - assertions for the new shape: goal-variable schema, loop adjacency (no fail-stay anywhere), banned strings, time-containment (no clock times outside the offer step), single-extraction-definition check. 9. HARNESS PLAN - today's 33 scenarios re-expressed as goal-loop tests plus convergence/fail-open/latency/goal-persistence scenarios (e.g. patient changes the range three times - goal refines, never resets). 10. MIGRATION - build/validate/mint/harness/flip sequence and what of tonight's v94-mint work carries over (conflict-node convergence design becomes the loop's ambiguity branch). 11. OPEN QUESTIONS FOR ANKIT - each with a recommended default. 12. Machine line: 'TARGET_NODES=<n> FROM=48 SPINE=goal-loop'. Final message <=15 lines.
tasks.check: grep -qE 'TARGET_NODES=(8|9|1[0-4]) FROM=48 SPINE=goal-loop' SPEC-v94-draft2.md || { echo "FAIL: machine line missing or node target outside 8-14: $(grep -m1 'TARGET_NODES=' SPEC-v94-draft2.md)"; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'GOAL OBJECT' SPEC-v94-draft2.md || { echo 'FAIL: no goal-object section'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'TURN CONTRACT' SPEC-v94-draft2.md || { echo 'FAIL: no turn contract'; exit 1; }; c=$(grep -cE 'n_[a-z_0-9]+' SPEC-v94-draft2.md); [ "$c" -ge 25 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $c node refs - contraction table incomplete"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'offered date + 7' SPEC-v94-draft2.md || { echo 'FAIL: correction ruling not embedded'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'goal.*(never resets|refines|persists)' SPEC-v94-draft2.md || { echo 'FAIL: goal-persistence principle not stated'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'OPEN QUESTIONS' SPEC-v94-draft2.md || { echo 'FAIL: no open questions'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'TARGET_NODES=' SPEC-v94-draft2.md); $c node refs"
tasks.verified: The v94 spec rebuilt around Ankit's persistent-goal architecture: one goal object that refines until satisfied, a deterministic turn contract replacing scenario routing, 8-14 nodes from 48, every locked ruling embedded, with validator, harness, and migration plans - awaiting his review.
